notes.title: Our new game is offically realeased!
notes.content:
Hi dear players of Yetu game, our new Otome game, "My Vow to My Liege" is now offically realeased in BOTH Chinese and English! If you're interested, please come and have a look at it, and you will get the 1st week purchase discount for it! (*However, please note that the1st week discount will be over soon in a few hours, so come and get it if you want it!:) )

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1146970/_/

《My Vow to My Liege》is a visual novel dating game. Players get to play as a girl disguised as the King of Ng, a man. The 4 dateable characters are: the guide, the enemy, the minister and the guard.Will they choose the man over the country? Love over hate? Who will they finally end up with?

notes.title: The Endless Journey OST New Free Downloads
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for your support! We are taking this opportunity while our sale is still on to give you these 3 MP3s from The Endless Journey: 
1. The BGM from the animals' memory picture book ( Title： Once Upon A Time)
2. The tune the girl at the inn was humming (Title: Mother Goose)
3. This requiem was played by Ivry's father on the piano at the inn. Ivry's father was also featured in 《Price》. (Title: Requiem (Piano Version))
For the people who bought The Endless Journey OST, these 3 MP3 files will be automatically added into your local folder after you have downloaded the update.

I hope everyone will enjoy it!:aboutlove:

notes.title: New DLC updates！
notes.content:
【New DLC updates】
※Spoiler Alert※
Please finish one playthrough before downloading the new DLC.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1015860/The_Endless_JourneyAudio_Picture_Book/

Let Father Myriel tell all you Cosette a story. Who was the dog's owner? Why was the cat thrown out? The chicken was actually...

【This update will include】
1. Four audio picture books
2. Pdf files for all CGs in the game
3. New animations for game endings
4. Unlock all picture book achievements
5. All images are translated into English

【Instructions】
Install the > DLC in that folder.
After installing the new DLC, go to your Steam Library and right click on the 《The Endless Journey》from the menu on the left. From where you right-clicked, a menu will drop down. Then go to Properties - Local Files - Browse Local Files to view the new contents. 

【Additional Content】
We are very sorry to have kept you waiting for this so, we have decided：

1. All 4 picture book achievements that are supposed to be achieved initially through playing the game will be given after the first cut scene at the train station. So that everyone who has played it once wouldn't have to replay it again!

2. For those who have gotten the 4 new achievements and have at least a 2hr gameplay time on it, please send us a screenshot of your achievements and total game time to our customer service email at 2535104877@qq.com (Please be sure that the screenshot includes your name and other details, so we know whom to send the activation code to.)

Once that is done, we will send you an activation code for either a DLC or a special feature. (PRICE is free, but the DLCs are not. You can specify what you want, but if you don't, we will send you a random activation code for any of them. This special feature will up the total number of games own on steam a +1 without actually giving you a new game.)
(This offer ends on the 25th of February)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/465520/PRICE/

Lastly, we would like to thank everyone for playing our games and here's wishing you a happy Chinese New Year!!

notes.title: Must see before playing the game! Common problems solving method
notes.content:

A: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=778100591 

Q&A:If the game closes right after opening, you need to put the exe. under a file which contains ONLY English characters in its name, and then re-install the game.  


Q&A：If you are getting an error window popping up, example: missing dll, it could be due to Steam's C language installation package is incomplete. Please download the game at the address below.↓
https://twitter.com/yetuavg/status/1073505437419429888


Q: And download content or update plan?
A: There will be four animals picture and 4 achievements. We will release them in the future in free. In addition, the game picture will remake by Shaohuo. This will make the game style more uniform. This will update in the future.

A: No problem. Thanks a lot.

All above. Enjoy your game!

notes.title: 20% off!!English version update!
notes.content:
20% off for half a month！

The current update will fix the following to the new English version of this game:
+ Fixed the bug of any incomplete English translations
+ Fixed the animation of the Live 2D program that causes a few of the dialogue interface to result in a white screen.
+ Added the option to turn the hints on/off.
+ Skipping Mini Games

In this current update we have also asked @Teleute_Eirene to edit our dialogues, descriptions of collections, character introductions and other English translations to give you a better translated story. 

In the next update, we will be replacing all the translated text in the images to that done by @Teleute_Eirene. So please look forward to it.:aboutlove:

notes.title: A Change of Email Address!
notes.content:
After 2 weeks of trying to fix our email server, we have found that our previous email address, service@yetuavg.com can no longer receive any incoming mails and letters. So we have changed our customer service email to 2535104877@qq.com. We are very sorry for the inconvenience and asked that you will sent any future emails to the new email address. In addition to that, if you have sent us any emails within the past two weeks, we asked that you will kindly re-sent us your emails to the new address. 

Thank you very much!

notes.title: English player attention
notes.content:
We are so sorry! I have been in the hospital for a period of time because of the waist plate problem. I did not see the questions given in time!ːupsetmonkː

When selecting the English language, do not start the game directly. Play the game with the "englishbeta" version of the game. We fixed the following questions:

1. For a few computers gets a white screen in the dialogue - After checking it was the originally live2d dynamic state plugin conflict with a computer configuration.  So now all the painted draw are the static version and redraw everything. The painting style is more unified now.

2. Repaired the missing translation problem.

3. Optimized the grammar mistakes that everyone proposed.

4.After updating, you can check the [hints] in [system]  screen.


Update method:

In the steam client - library - Right-click the game name on the left -  properties - language-English - test - version selection "englishbeta"


Finally, we apologize to every English player once again. We will add the English players who gave us feedback and provide compensation.


In the next update, we will release more content and update the englishbeta version to the public version. Thank you for your support.ːaboutloveː

notes.title: English update
notes.content:
【Enabling Hints】
If checked,importantcluesin the game willshimmerone by one to give you hints. (Collectibles and clues for secondary events will not shimmer.)

【Skipping Mini Games】
Five seconds after a mini game starts, a skip button will appear in the bottom left corner (not all mini games can be skipped).

 Thank you for your support.:aboutlove:

notes.title: Must see before playing the game! Common problems solving method
notes.content:
Q: Game video crashed or low fluent(No matter if this happen we recommend you set up like this. It will be more fluent)
A: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=778100591 


 
Q: Some old version video card in live2d dynamic dialogue scene appears white screen, can not see the picture.
A: We have received this feedback! But currently this situation appears rarely. We have not get solution for this problem OTL. If you meet this problem, please leave comments in community. We will collect your computer configuration in order to find out the reason as soon as possible.

Q: Will the game have hints function in the future?
A: Thanks for your suggestion. We have added flash prompts. It did not get any problem in beta testing. We will update it in next version=3=

Q: How to switch game language into Chinese?
A: Please uninstall game English version. Open Steam - right click game - Properties - Language - Simplified Chinese. We still suggest you to install simplified Chinese version if you are traditional Chinese user because it has no problem~

Q: Will the game have CG appreciation?
A: We will publish an digital version of game collection which include all CG and characters design.

Q: And download content or update plan?
A: There will be four animals picture and 4 achievements. We will release them in the future in free. In addition, the game picture will remake by Shaohuo. This will make the game style more uniform. This will update in the future.

Q: Is this game allow to live broadcasting?
A: No problem. Thanks a lot.

All above. Enjoy your game!
